Class SysMLRequirement

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.occurrences.SysMLOccurrence
sysmlinjava.constraint.SysMLConstraint
sysmlinjava.requirements.SysMLRequirement
Direct Known Subclasses:
SysMLConcern, SysMLViewpoint
public class SysMLRequirement extends SysMLConstraint
SysMLinJava representation of the SysML requirement. This SysMLRequirement is an extension of the SysMLConstraint, so the actual requirement specification is contained in the features of the SysMLConstraint, i.e. in the function (formal constraint as code) or text (informal constraint as text) variables.

Requirements are created/specified as instances of the SysMLRequirement in an extension of the SysMLRequirementsCollection class. These requirement instances can then be used in references to requirements in parts, ports, items, etc.

Author:
ModelerOne

    • csvFormatAttributes

      public static final String csvFormatAttributes
      String format for CSV import of requirement. Requirement is defined completely in single line of text. Line is CSV (using vertical bars instead of commas) of single instance attributes, followed by kev-value strings for user-defined attributes and for each dependencies list. Example CSV for a requirements is as follows. 
      
	1.2.3.4|Title of the requirement|Text spec of the requirement|Functional|Demonstration|Medium|Proposed|1|R Lee|U Grant|myAtt1=[This is my firstAttribute],myAtt2=[This is my secondAttribute]|derivedFrom=[1.1, 4.2.1],verifiedBy=[FunctionalTestCase,PerformanceTestCase,InterfaceTestCase];
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • csvFormatUserDefined

      public static final String csvFormatUserDefined
      String format for CSV import of requirement user-defined attributes that is in a bar-separated field in the CSV line. Field consists of a key-value string pair where the key is the attribute name and the value is a brackets-enclosed string. An example follows. 
      
	userAtt1=[This is a user-defined attribute],userAtt2=[This is another user-defined attribute]
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • csvFormatDependency

      public static final String csvFormatDependency
      String format for CSV import of requirement dependency list that is in a bar-separated field in the CSV line. Field consists of a key-value string pair where the key is the dependency name and the value is a comma-separated set of names of the dependency target. An example follows. 
      
	derivedFrom=[1.1, 4.2.1],verifiedBy=[FunctionalTestCase,PerformanceTestCase,InterfaceTestCase]

  • Constructor Details

    • SysMLRequirement

      public SysMLRequirement(String identifier, String title, String constraintText, Optional<SysMLRequirementConstraintFunction> constraintFunction, Optional<Class<? extends SysMLOccurrence>> subject, List<Class<? extends SysMLStakeholder>> stakeholders, List<SysMLConcern> concerns, List<Class<? extends SysMLPart>> actors, Boolean isAssumption, List<SysMLConstraint> assumed, RequirementCategoryEnum category, List<Class<? extends SysMLOccurrence>> allocatedTo, List<SysMLVerificationMethodKind> verificationMethods, List<Class<? extends SysMLVerificationCase>> verifiedBy, List<SysMLHyperlink> supportingInformationLinks)
      Constructor for constraint-defined requirement. Has no specific occurrence so, if needed, occurrence must be set via explicit assignment after constructor. Arguments: Arguments:
      Parameters:
      identifier - requirement's unique identifier
      title - requirement's unique title
      constraintText - requirement specified with simple text documentation as informal non-executable constraint
      constraintFunction - requirement specified as formal executable constraint as lambda function
      subject - optional class of subject of this requirement
      stakeholders - list of classes of stakeholders for this requirement, if any
      concerns - list of names of instances of concerns addressed by this requirement, if any
      actors - list of classes of actors involved in this requirement, if any
      isAssumption - whether this requirement is an assumption for another requirement
      assumed - list of names of instances of assumptions/constraints for this requirement, if any
      category - requirement's category
      allocatedTo - list of class of parts, ports, actions, items to which this requirement is allocated
      verificationMethods - List of verification methods used for verification of this requirement
      verifiedBy - list of class names of verification cases that verify this requirement was satisfied
      supportingInformationLinks - list of names of instances of SysMLHyperlinks to information that supports this requirement, e.g. link(s) to another document(s) that specify the requirements that compose this requirement.
